title: Wazuh alert document
description: Subset of the Wazuh alert document that the AI SOC Assistant classifier actually reads. Wazuh emits many more fields; only those consulted by the workflow (or commonly present in the examples) are constrained here. Status: describes real input consumed by the implemented workflow.

_index.description: Index name. A value starting with 'wazuh-' is one of the signals for the wazuh_json classification fallback.

source.description: The alert body. The classifier reads parsed._source ?? parsed, so these fields may also appear at the document root.

decoder.description: Decoder metadata. decoder.name drives classification for windows_eventchannel, fortigate, paloalto, f5 and linux.

predecoder.description: predecoder.program_name === 'cef' is one half of the Trend Micro CEF classification test.

rule.description: Detection metadata. Explains why the alert fired. Per the system prompts this is NOT evidence that malicious activity occurred.

level.description: Wazuh rule level. Mapped to severity by the Wazuh prompt as 0-2 Informational, 3-5 Low, 6-9 Medium, 10-12 High, 13-16 Critical. The numeric value must not be printed in the report.

groups.description: Rule groups. Drives classification for windows, windows_security, fortigate, paloalto, f5, trendmicro and linux.

mitre.description: A mapping on the rule. Never sufficient on its own to conclude the technique executed.
